description: Original narrow paraphrases of rule facts for deterministic pipeline evaluation, not an official rulebook or a live-model relevance benchmark. Vectors are hand assigned; no commercial text is copied.

documents.text: A settlement is worth one victory point.
Building a road costs one brick and one lumber.
When a seven is rolled, players with more than seven resource cards discard half, rounded down.
A city receives two resources from each adjacent producing terrain hex.
